emphasis_points: Detail specific organizational architecture tailored to the piece: TV units for media routing, console equipment ventilation, and soundbar placement; bookshelves for vertical tiered displays and load capacity; shoe racks for ventilated footwear storage and entryway cleanliness; cabinets/sideboards for concealed tableware or bulk living room organization.
Highlight door hardware (louvered slats, fluted glass, soft-glide hinges) and compartment proportions based on verifiable dimensions.
Describe perimeter wall presence and how clean architectural lines reduce visual clutter across the living area.
avoid_list: Do not invent internal cable management ports, LED backlighting, or adjustable shelf pegs not specified in attributes.
Do not assume televisions, electronics, books, or decorative objects shown in lifestyle imagery are included.
Do not assert universal screen size compatibility without verifying tabletop length against standard TV base dimensions.
tone_notes: Organized, architectural, and dependable, prioritizing clutter-free spatial flow, verified compartment utility, and enduring joinery.
